comparison_type: exploratory descriptive assessment of five scans in one session
coordinate_assumption: default orthogonal Slicer views, without additional transforms
limitations: No repeated acquisitions or independent subjects
No cross-scan rigid or eye-motion registration
ROI locations are manually selected exploratory samples, not validated segmentations
Spatial variation inside magnitude images is not a calibrated noise estimate
1-mm output grid does not establish true resolution or separation of ocular-wall layers

fallacy_scan_notes.Simpson: Both eyes reported separately; no reversal in main signal direction
fallacy_scan_notes.ecological: No population inference; voxels are not independent replicates
fallacy_scan_notes.regression_to_mean: No selection of subjects by extreme baseline
fallacy_scan_notes.look_elsewhere: No hypothesis tests or selective significance reporting
fallacy_scan_notes.forking_paths: Exploratory ROI selection disclosed, native neighbouring planes inspected
fallacy_scan_notes.causality: Apparent parameter trends remain confounded by scan-to-scan motion and field/receive effects
